system.description:
Whether by blood or by boon, the Majesty of Dragons equals power. Enticing, elusive, exquisite.

LEVEL 3

Elemental Affinity. Gain Affinity with a damage type from among the spells you know. You do not gain disadvantage from adjacent enemies when casting Affinity spells.

Brilliant Scales. Gain resistance to your Affinity and +KEY armor. Dragons are more likely to consider you a friend… or rival.

LEVEL 7

Formidable Claws. Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6+KEY Affinity damage. You may spend mana (up to your highest unlocked spell tier) to add +KEY damage for each point of mana spent.

LEVEL 11

Fearsome Breath. 2 actions: Deal KEY Affinity damage in either Cone 3 or Line 6. You may spend mana (up to your highest unlocked spell tier) to add +KEY damage for each point of mana spent. Half damage on a DEX save (DC 10+KEY).

LEVEL 15

Glorious Wings. Gain a Fly speed.

Blinding Majesty. (1/Safe Rest) 2 actions: All enemies that can see you become Dazed, and must make a WIL save (DC 10+KEY) or become Blinded until your next turn.
